jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**Build a safer world with us, one incident at a time.**


Ambient.ai is the category creator and leader in Agentic Physical Security. Powered by Ambient Pulsar, the first reasoning Vision\-Language Model purpose\-built for physical security, our platform seamlessly integrates with existing security cameras and physical access control systems to unify monitoring, access control, threat assessment, response, and investigations through an always\-on reasoning layer that augments security operators with superhuman capabilities. The results: 95% fewer false alarms, investigations 20x faster, and 10x faster response.


The momentum speaks for itself: we doubled new ARR in FY26, and have delivered results for world\-class customers including Cisco, ServiceNow, SentinelOne, TikTok, Bayer, and MoMA. That kind of momentum creates an environment where great people thrive, and it shows: we recently ranked \#71 out of 500 on the Forbes best startup employers list.


Founded in 2017 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, and Allegion Ventures, Ambient.ai is on a fast\-paced journey to fulfill our mission: prevent every security incident possible.


Ready to learn more? Connect with us on **LinkedIn** and **YouTube**

**About the role:**


We are looking for a high\-energy, proactive, and tech\-savvy Office Manager who wants to wear many hats and to serve as the backbone of our daily operations. You won’t just be sitting behind a desk; you will be the curator of our environment, the architect of our celebrations, and the first line of support for our team.

**What you'll do:**

* Environmental Pride: Take full ownership of the office aesthetic. This includes daily rounds to ensure conference rooms are "client\-ready," the kitchen is pristine, and the coffee is flowing.
* The Seamless Employee Lifecycle: You will own the new hire experience. This means being innovative and obsessed with the details—ensuring every laptop is delivered on time, every desk is perfectly set up with swag, and every new employee feels welcomed and ready to contribute on Day 1\.
* Events \& Culture: Bring the "fun" through creative, well\-organized and detail\-oriented event planning. You’ll manage our company swag and lead the Anniversary Recognition Program with meticulous organization.
* Tech\-savvy: We are a tech\-forward company \- you should be comfortable using, Google Suite, specifically Google Sheets and can create basic equations, Google slides, AI tools and can troubleshoot basic IT tools such as Zoom rooms if IT Manager is not available.
* Vendor management \& financial rigor: Manage office expenses and vendor costs to optimize budget and find savings whenever possible.
* Visitor Experience: Provide an Ambient Class experience with professional energy, ensuring interviewees and customers feel welcome.
* Office Compliance \& Safety: Ownership of workplace safety and regulatory compliance. This includes maintaining up\-to\-date knowledge of local health and safety regulations (OSHA), managing office security protocols (badge access, guest logs), etc.
* India Office Support: Order office supplies, coordinate onboarding
* Other Responsibilities: Office lead for replica weapon testing process, manage and lead company meetings every Friday, and other duties as they arise

**What you'll bring:**

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree is preferred
* Proven Experience: 2\+ years in Office Management, Event Management, or a similar high\-touch operational role. Experience in a high\-growth startup environment is a significant plus.
* Able to lift 25\+ lbs
* The Embodiment of "Ambient Class" \& "Own It": You are a self\-starter who takes immense pride in your work. You represent Ambient Class through discretion and a "white\-glove" standard, fixing problems before they arise. You don’t need a map to execute; you simply own the physical and cultural health of the office, knowing that every detail matters.
* Proactive \& Fast: You operate with a sense of urgency and have a "no task too small" attitude—you’ll jump from a budget spreadsheet to onboarding a new hire without missing a beat.
* Professional \& Discreet: You are a high\-level communicator who knows how to hold a crowd's attention but also knows when to maintain strict confidentiality.
* The "Kind No": You are approachable and helpful, yet firm in maintaining office policies and budgets.
* Tech Savvy: You are an expert in Google Suite (Sheets/Excel) and eager to use AI technology to solve manual problems.
* Reliable: You take pride in being the first one in the door to ensure the team is set up for success by 9:00 AM.

**Why join us:**

* We are creating an entirely new category within a 120\+ billion\-dollar physical security industry, and we’re looking for team members who share our mission to prevent every security incident possible
* We have an impressive customer roster of F500 companies, including Adobe, TikTok, and SentinelOne
* Regular full\-time employees receive stock options for the opportunity to share in the success of our company
* Comprehensive health \+ welfare package (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, EAP, Legal Services, 401k plan)
* We offer flexible time off to rest and recharge, including Winter Break (time off between Christmas and New Year’s for most roles depending on customer demand)
* The latest tech and awesome swag will be delivered to your door
* Enjoy a full range of opportunities to connect with your awesome co\-workers
* We love to hike, are foodies, and love music! Check out our most recent Ambient Spotify Playlist

jobs.title: Training Coordinator, UCPath Campus Operations (5411C), People & Culture #88891
jobs.description:
Training Coordinator, UCPath Campus Operations (5411C), People \& Culture \#88891 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

People \& Culture is valued as UC Berkeley's proactive people partner, focusing on the following key priority areas:
  
  

**One HR:** Bringing clarity and efficiency to HR processes and structures through cross\- team collaboration and transparent communication.
  
  

**People:** Using development opportunities beyond training to create deeper engagement, higher trust, and better performance.
  
  

**Culture:** Applying the Berkeley brand to develop a shared "enterprise contributor" mindset among all.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

Berkeley's UCPath Training Coordinator serves as the campus trainer for UCPath, leading the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training and learning resources supporting UCPath and related business processes at UC Berkeley. The position provides campus\-wide UCPath training and access support, including training required for expanded UCPath access and associated security and segregation\-of\-duties requirements.
  
  

The position assesses training needs, develops and maintains accessible curriculum and learning resources, and delivers training through multiple modalities, including instructor\-led, virtual, eLearning, microlearning, and other learning solutions. The role supports employees at all levels, from new users to experienced transactional users and supervisors, and evaluates training effectiveness to continuously improve the program.
  
  

The position partners with Berkeley's UCPath Operations team, subject matter experts, business owners, UCPath Center/UC Office of the President, organizational change management, and other campus partners to translate complex system, policy, and process changes into clear and effective learning experiences. The role also supports training communications, Communities of Practice, and change management activities and helps evolve the campus training model as UCPath processes and related technologies, including ServiceNow, change.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

The First Review Date for this job is October 2, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

20%
  
  

Leads the campus UCPath training program, assessing training needs, evaluating effectiveness, and developing training strategies aligned with system, policy, and business process changes.
  
  

25%
  
  

Develops and maintains digitally accessible UCPath curriculum and learning resources for diverse audiences, including instructor\-led training, eLearning, microlearning, job aids, webinars, and other learning solutions.
  
  

20%
  
  

Delivers and facilitates UCPath training through in\-person, virtual, and other modalities, adapting content and delivery methods to meet the needs and learning styles of various audiences.
  
  

10%
  
  

Manages UCPath training operations and learning systems, including course structure, scheduling, prerequisites, registration, completion tracking, and coordination with the campus learning management system team.
  
  

15%
  
  

Partners with UCPath Operations, UCPath/UCOP, subject matter experts, business owners, OCM, and campus stakeholders to coordinate training and support readiness for system, policy, and process changes.
  
  

5%
  
  

Supports UCPath communications, Communities of Practice/Focus Groups, and change management activities, including training\-related website, email newsletter, and other user resources.
  
  

5%
  
  

Participates in professional development to maintain and expand knowledge of instructional design, adult learning, learning technologies, UCPath, and related business processes, as well as pursue other professional development opportunities relevant to the position and career growth.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
  

Thorough knowledge of training and development principles, adult learning theory, instructional design, and learning methodologies.
  
Thorough knowledge of training needs assessment, curriculum development, training delivery, and evaluation.
  
Strong ability to translate complex technical, system, policy, and process information into clear, effective learning experiences for diverse audiences.
  
Exceptional verbal, written, interpersonal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess issues, identify training needs, and develop practical recommendations.
  
Experience developing and maintaining training materials and learning resources across multiple modalities, including instructor\-led training, virtual learning, eLearning, microlearning, job aids, and webinars.
  
Ability to manage multiple training prog

jobs.title: Front Desk / Guest Services & Spa Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**Front Desk / Guest Services \& Spa Operations Associate**

Piedmont Springs \| Oakland, CA  
Part\-Time \| Day Shifts: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM \| 5\-Day Availability Required  
Must include Saturday, Sunday, Monday \& Tuesday

Piedmont Springs is looking for a friendly, dependable, energetic person to join our Guest Services team.

**First, an important note: this is not a sedentary receptionist position.**

Although every member of our Guest Services team works at the front desk, this is an **active, hands\-on position**. Our staff rotate between front\-desk responsibilities and helping operate the spa throughout the shift.

On any given shift, you may be checking in guests and answering phones one moment, then walking through the facility to reset spa rooms, handle towels and laundry, check restrooms and common areas, restock supplies, or assist with other operational needs the next.

**If you're looking for a job where you'll spend most of your shift sitting behind a desk, this probably isn't the right position for you.**

On the other hand, if you enjoy staying busy, moving around, helping customers, working independently, and having different things to do throughout your shift, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

Our Guest Services staff are responsible for helping provide a welcoming experience for our customers while keeping the spa operating smoothly. Responsibilities include:

* Greeting customers and providing friendly, professional service
* Checking guests in and processing payments
* Answering phones and booking appointments
* Learning our services and helping customers select and schedule them
* Maintaining accurate reservations and customer information in our scheduling system
* Handling gift card purchases and redemptions
* Handling cash and maintaining an accurate cash drawer
* Walking first\-time guests through the facility and explaining how their service works
* Monitoring appointment times and helping keep spa rooms running on schedule
* Resetting hot tub, sauna and steam rooms between guests
* Collecting, washing, drying and folding towels and other laundry
* Checking restrooms, guest areas and common areas throughout the shift and cleaning or restocking them as needed
* Restocking towels, water, tea, bathroom supplies and other items
* Performing routine water\-chemistry checks and other basic spa\-operating procedures after training
* Helping identify and report facility or equipment issues
* Completing routine daytime shift procedures
* Pitching in wherever needed to keep the spa clean, organized and running smoothly

These responsibilities reflect the actual mix of customer\-service and operating duties at Piedmont Springs, including room turnover, laundry, cleanliness, stocking, chemical checks and general facility responsibilities.

**The Person We're Looking For**

We're less concerned about whether you've worked at a spa before than whether you have the right approach to work.

You'll probably enjoy this position if you:

* **Like staying busy** and prefer an active job to sitting in one place all day
* Naturally notice when something needs to be done and take care of it
* Are friendly and comfortable interacting with many different types of people
* Can remain calm and organized when several things need attention at once
* Take pride in keeping your workplace clean and presentable
* Are comfortable cleaning guest areas and restrooms when necessary
* Don't mind handling towels, doing laundry or performing other hands\-on tasks
* Are dependable and understand that your coworkers are counting on you to show up for scheduled shifts
* Can follow detailed procedures while also using good judgment
* Are comfortable working independently without needing constant direction
* Pay attention to details, particularly when handling reservations, payments and customer requests
* Are willing to learn and accept feedback
* Have a genuine "pitch in and help" attitude

Previous customer\-service, hospitality, retail, restaurant, spa or similar experience is helpful, but **attitude, reliability and work ethic matter more to us than having a particular background.**

**Schedule — Please Read Before Applying**

We are currently hiring specifically for our daytime team.

Applicants must be able to regularly work approximately:

10:00 AM–4:00 PM

This opening requires ongoing availability at least five days per week, including Saturday, Sunday, Monday and Tuesday. Your fifth available day may be Wednesday, Thursday or Friday.

Please apply only if this schedule fits your ongoing availability. We are looking for someone who can reliably maintain this availability rather than someone seeking temporary daytime work.

**Physical \& Work Environment**

This is an active position. Team members spend significant portions of their shifts **standing and walking throughout the facility**, including moving between floors and different areas of the spa.

The job also involves routine activities such as handling laundry and towels, bending and reaching while resetting or stocking areas, and working around the warm and humid environment associated with hot tubs, saunas and steam rooms.

**About Piedmont Springs**

Piedmont Springs is a neighborhood spa in Oakland offering private outdoor hot tubs, sauna and steam, massage, skincare and other wellness services.

We've been serving the community for decades, and our goal is simple: provide customers with a welcoming, relaxing experience in a clean and well\-run environment.

That takes more than someone sitting behind a counter. It takes a team of people who notice what needs to be done and are willing to do it.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 2026\-4666 Job Summary:

The Program Manager will serve as the single point of accountability for all contractor performance under the for a large\-scale federal communications contract. The Program Manager will be responsible for overseeing a team delivering event support, toolkit development, research and analysis, and Resilience Challenge support to state, local, tribal, and territorial (SLTT) stakeholders. The Program Manager directs day\-to\-day execution of the contract and serves as the primary liaison to the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR).

  

The Program Manager role requires a self\-starter, proactive problem solver and action\-oriented team player with previous experience in management consulting and business development pursuits. This position needs an individual that is committed to providing superior service, poised under pressure and has a positive and flexible attitude.

  

This is a contingent hire position. Offers will be contingent upon client approval, ability to meet security requirements, and the ability to adhere to any on\-site requirements (which may change at contract award).

  

Remote work is anticipated. However, candidates must be within commuting distance to Washington, DC metro area for client engagements.


Primary Responsibilities:
* Serve as Artemis’s Key Personnel and single point of accountability to the COR for all contractor work performed under the CISA SLTT Communications Support contract.
* Direct and supervise a team of at least three full\-time staff delivering event support, toolkit development, research and analysis, and Resilience Challenge support to CISA and SLTT stakeholders.
* Plan and oversee execution of up to two live events per contract year (e.g., conferences, summits, roundtables, CISA Day on the Hill) and up to four livestreamed events (e.g., webinars, fireside chats), including agendas, speaker coordination, invitations, RSVP tracking, logistics, and staffing.
* Oversee development of a cybersecurity and physical security toolkit for SLTT stakeholders, including fact sheets, statistics, short videos, and customizable templates.
* Direct research and analysis efforts on SLTT\-level cybersecurity volunteer program best practices and SLTT awareness of CISA resources and the effectiveness of public communications.
* Oversee Artemis’s support of the CISA Resilience Challenge, including engagement planning, identification of SLTT success stories, the associated social media campaign, and the public capstone event.
* Prepare and submit monthly progress reports and a Project Plan to the Contracting Officer and COR, and represent Artemis at any contractor and Government required meetings.
* Ensure continuity of contractor staffing and notify the COR of any anticipated coverage gaps or key personnel changes.
* Ensure all contractor personnel understand and comply with DHS rules, regulations, and policies concerning safety, security, and records management.
* Maintain overall quality, schedule, and budget accountability for all contract deliverables.

Minimum Qualifications:
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in program/project management, communications, marketing, or a related field, including experience on federal government contracts.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field (Master’s degree or MBA preferred).
* Currently holds, or is able to obtain, a DHS Fitness Determination/DHS Suitability.
* Demonstrated experience serving as Key Personnel or in a similarly accountable Program/Project Manager role on a federal contract, including direct supervision of staff.
* Experience managing communications, marketing, or outreach programs for a federal health, homeland security, or public sector client.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
* Ability to obtain and maintain DHS Suitability/a Public Trust clearance.
* Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications:
* Strong critical thinking, analytical and time management skills.
* Proven ability to organize, prioritize and work well with others.
* Ability to communicate thoughts, ideas and solutions logically both written and orally.
* Ability to stay calm under pressure and in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to receive feedback from clients and implement changes quickly and effectively.
* Ability to get up to speed quickly on complex issues.
* Desire to work in a fast\-paced, rapidly evolving environment.
